svg.aria-label: Speculative decoding: a small helper guesses words, the big model checks them at once
svg.title: Speculative decoding: a small helper guesses words, the big model checks them at once
svg.text: Guess, then check - many words per step
A small, fast helper inside the model guesses the next words. The big model checks all the guesses in one go
and keeps the ones it agrees with. The big model decides every word - it just arrives 1.6-1.8x sooner.
